name: HONG RI DA Technology Company Limited
summary: HONG RI DA Technology Company Limited engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision electronic connectors and metal components in China. The company offers mobile phone cards, memory cards, battery holders, headphone sockets, USB, FPC, BTB, and RF connectors; USB type C; and antenna shrapnel series. It also provides K-shaped tee, gear, smart ring, fixed seat, screw positioning column, suction stems, nuts, fingerprint brackets, camera brackets, shaft, sealing brackets, USB iron shells, card hooks, racks, drive blocks, fans, tooth firmware, shaft sleeves, button stands, deflectors, buckles, conversion shells, shelfs, tooth firmware, connecting shells, telescopic decor…
